description: This file defines the CategoriesProvider class, which manages category data in a Flutter application. It interacts with a database helper to load, add, update, and delete categories, and notifies listeners of data changes.

classes.name: CategoriesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing categories, providing methods to load, add, update, and delete categories, and notifying listeners on changes.

methods.name: CategoriesProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider and loads categories from the database.

methods.name: loadCategories
methods.description: Asynchronously loads categories from the database and updates internal list.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Inserts a new category into the database and reloads the categories list.

methods.name: updateCategory
methods.description: Updates an existing category in the database and reloads the categories list.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes a category by ID from the database and reloads the categories list.

methods.name: getCategoryById
methods.description: Returns a category matching the specified ID, or null if not found.
